subject: Contagion
advisory: Burn dose sizes, tells lead, Coalescence stage timings and the mutation deck weights are tuning; scenes check sign and order, never the number

Table (defName: special): RM_BloodyMess, RM_Scorchpod, RM_InfectedAerofleet: deathAction DeathActionProperties_ScaledExplosion; RM_Skinflap, RM_Gorekite, RM_Danglemaw, RM_Crispling, RM_Sloshbelly, RM_Ogleknot: deathAction DeathActionProperties_Vanish; RM_Scorchpod: listed in RM_Contagion's RM_ContagionSkyExtension leakerNatives; RM_Scaldhide, RM_Crispling: listed in armoredNatives; RM_Gnashling: herdAnimal; RM_Bloodlurk, RM_Eyestinger, RM_Danglemaw: predator; RM_Peeper: not a predator; RM_ContagionIkee: defName present and distinct from any vanilla or donor ikee defName; RM_SparkleechGrub: grounded (no MaxFlightTime) while RM_Sparkleech flies; RM_Blisterfloat: MaxFlightTime declared and canLeaveMapFlying; RM_InfectedAerofleet: body RM_BullooBody; RM_OcularJelly: body RM_ZhoolBody, renderTree RM_OcularJelly_Twitch with life stages; RM_InfectedAerofleet and RM_OcularJelly: VEF CompProperties_Floating and CompProperties_AsexualReproduction declared (a def read, run without VEF loaded; the live VEF behaviour is out of this leaf because VEF is not on the minimal list). leaves.oracle_proposed: each declared field present on the post-patch def (terrain its own, plant and animal density nonzero, forage zero; no density value is read); every disease def resolves; RustPuff present with TheRot and absent without; TentacularPlant absent from wildPlants; validate_patch reports every operation matched; the workerClass's GetScore is -100 or less on every return and biomeRarityFactor is absent from every Contagion .cs file

The scoped-out placement worker is retired: the workerClass on RM_Contagion never scores a tile and no rarity setting remains.
leaves.scenario: Selftest over the post-patch RM_Contagion def: the fingerprinted offline def dump (refresh.py) read only when its fingerprint matches the current mod set, else UNMEASURED; the RustPuff guard parsed with and without TheRot's packageId, every disease def in the disease table resolved in that dump, and validate_patch.py over RM_AcousticPayload_Contagion.xml with --defs. Absence arm, over RM_Contagion.xml and src/RimMandrake/Contagion/Source: the workerClass named on the BiomeDef has a GetScore that returns -100 or less on every return, and biomeRarityFactor appears in no Contagion .cs file; red until RIMMANDRAKE_RETIRE_CONTAGION_BIOME_SCORER_WORLD_IS_FROZEN lands.
